name: den
title: Den — Doto's home
description: See what the companion learned about you and edit or forget any of it by pointing: persona, traits, likes, nicknames, memory, special skills and the secret moves you found.

den.persona.set.summary: The human renamed him, edited the tagline, settled a trait slider (debounced 250 ms) or picked a colour: {name?, tagline?, traits?:{k:0..1}, color?}

den.persona.reset.summary: The human pressed Reset to defaults and confirmed it in the window: {}

den.like.add.summary: The human typed a new like: {text}

den.like.forget.summary: The human pressed × on a like: {text}

den.dislike.add.summary: The human typed a new dislike: {text}

den.dislike.forget.summary: The human pressed × on a dislike: {text}

den.nickname.set.summary: The human added or edited a nickname (what they call a thing): {key, value}

den.memory.forget.summary: The human pressed × on a memory line: {ts, text} (text = 80-char preview)

den.skill.forget.summary: The human removed a special skill: {name}

den.skill.rate.summary: Thumbs up or down on a special skill: {name, ok}

den.ask.summary: Ask, or a question from Doto's menu: {question, about:{section, id?, text?}, entity}; about is the row they were looking at

den.export.summary: "Send to Claude": everything he knows, for review: {entity, pending?}. The engine saves it as a session and closes the window (handoff); answer in the transcript.

den.snapshot.summary: Answer to the den.snapshot command (re = command id): {entity, pending?}

den.load.summary: Render this payload: {entity, merge?}; merge:true patches only the sections present. Clears pending marks on rows that now match.

den.refresh.summary: Re-fetch GET /lip/entity and render it; clears every pending mark

den.highlight.summary: Glow a section or one row: {section, id?, color?, ttl?}; ttl default 4000, 0 keeps, section "" clears

den.snapshot.summary: Ask the den for its current payload; it replies with a den.snapshot event
